name: Plugit Bulk Editor for WooCommerce
author: Plugit2wp.com

sections.description:
WooCommerce makes editing variable products painful.
You open a product, scroll to variations, edit one by one, save,
go back. Repeat 50 times.

Plugit Bulk Editor puts all your products and variations in one
table. Click a cell, type the new value, save. Done.

What you can do

  • Edit prices, stock, SKU and more across all variations at once
  • Expand/collapse variations inline — no page reloads
  • Filter by category, type or stock status
  • See exactly what changed before saving

Free vs Pro

The free version includes full inline editing for all your products
and variations with no limits.

Pro adds: Google Sheets sync, CSV export/import, Undo, and priority
support. Learn more at plugit2wp.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Smart Bulk Editor
sections.faq:
Does it work with variable products?

Yes. All variations are displayed with their attributes visible, and each can be edited independently.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes, fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Can I export my products?

Yes. Click Export CSV to download all visible products and variations including attributes.
